{"id":2517055307855,"title":"Vitamin C Face Serum","handle":"vitamin-c-anti-aging-serum-1-75oz","description":"
This Vitamin C Face Serum, infused with Ferulic Acid, Glycolic Acid, Lactic Acid, and Peptides, helps brighten and improve the look of uneven skin tone. The lightweight, gel serum reduces the appearance of dark spots for a visibly radiant, refreshed complexion.
  • Visibly improves uneven skin tone and texture.
  • Enhances brighten for a glowing complexion.
  • Helps reduce the appearance of dark spots.
  • Supports smoother, more radiant look.

How To Use

Apply a thin layer to clean face and neck in the morning. Follow with your favorite Advanced Clinicals face cream. Avoid using alongside Retinol. Use Vitamin C in the morning and Retinol at night.

Ingredients

Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C): A known antioxidant that helps brighten the look of dull skin, reduce the appearance of dark spots, and visibly improve uneven skin, revealing a more radiant looking complexion.

Ferulic Acid: Supports the brightening effects of Vitamin C to improve the look of uneven skin.

Glycolic Acid: An Alpha Hydroxy Acid (AHA) that exfoliates rough skin for softer, smoother looking skin.

Lactic Acid: An Alpha Hydroxy Acid (AHA) that exfoliates and visibly smooths dry, dull skin while drawing in moisture.

Disclaimer: We strive to maintain accurate ingredient information; however, ingredient lists may change due to innovative updates and evolving regulatory guidelines. For the most current details, please refer to the ingredient list on the product packaging.

care.formulaArchetype: Leave-on facial serum combining vitamin C (aminopropyl ascorbyl phosphate), ferulic acid, glycolic acid, lactic acid, and peptides, described by the manufacturer as brightening and improving uneven skin tone
care.advisoryBoundary: Supports everyday brightening and antioxidant protection. The exact concentrations, formula stability and clinical effect are not established, so do not present it as treatment for hyperpigmentation, melasma, acne, or another skin condition. Apply a thin layer in the morning and follow with sunscreen. Avoid using alongside retinol at the same time of day. Stop if it burns, stings, or irritates, and seek clinician advice for changing, painful, itchy, spreading, or persistent dark marks.
